notes.title: An updated De Mambo build has appeared!
notes.content:
From where you ask? Not sure. It was delivered to us by what seemed like a stork. Once it dropped off this new build into our hands, the stork recited a list. What did the list say you ask? Well, take a look here:

- Multiple controller support major overhaul! Controllers will now automatically order themselves as they are connected for all modes!

- Keyboard and controller configurations also majorly improved!

- Icons and text updates for all controllers!

TDK

notes.title: So It’s Come to This.
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30871566/852b2e5bf08cc6fd727090747aa5a3292447856c.jpg

As you can probably see, De Mambo is out today on Steam Early Access… or this is some crazy fever dream and we should cut down on the illegal paraphernalia—but enough about that!

We just wanted to say hello! How are things? Please don’t answer that as we can’t actually hear you…

Anyway, we’re really looking forward to this brand new relationship with you oh great Steam community and hope you enjoy the ride.

Until next time!

- TDK
